reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: 19.1 gives the professional-and-workmanlike standard plus material conformity to documentation/specifications; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty (running from the later of delivery or acceptance) and hosted Services conformity for the whole subscription term, which meets or exceeds the preferred 12-month software / 90-day services benchmark.

19.3 supplies the compliance-with-Applicable-Law and no-malicious-code elements, and 19.4 supplies the full repair/replace/re-perform remedy escalating to termination and refund of Fees, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
The 19.5 disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties: it is limited to implied warranties and expressly states no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy.

The failed deterministic check is a false negative from phrasing: the period is spelled out as 'ninety days' rather than in numerals/months, so the regex missed it; substantively the 90-day floor is satisfied.
No redline or comment is offered, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; nothing further is actionable.
